name: Good News Bar
notes: San Diego's alcohol-free bar/bottle shop (3821 Park Blvd). Menus page links to 8 dated 'Summer 2026' menu photo pages (coffee/tea, morning cocktails, tea/tincture add-ons, functional cocktails, free-spirited cocktails/botanical spirits/shots, wine/beer, small bites, wine flight/sweets) hosted as Squarespace image assets, no inline HTML prices. Serves genuine food (Small Bites, Sweets) alongside drinks, all itemized with current USD prices, so filed as found rather than blocked. Some items (e.g. Drip, Nitro Cold Brew, Premium Tea, Wines) show two prices for size/hot-iced/glass-bottle options; the lower/first price is recorded as canonical and both are noted in the description. Some cocktail names/prices repeat verbatim between the Morning and evening Functional Cocktails menus (e.g. Hand Me Downs, Star Room, Someone Like You, Live Forever, Weekend) — both listings kept since they are printed on two separate physical menu cards.

name: Frida’s Taqueria San Marcos
notes: Batch address (1158 W San Marcos Blvd, San Marcos, CA 92078) does not appear on the site's own /mapa/ locations page (only lists Escondido and Oceanside); confirmed via Serper Google Maps search that a 'Frida's Taqueria San Marcos' does exist at this exact address and links to this same website (eatsfridastaqueria.com) - the site's locations list is simply stale/incomplete. Same shared /menu/ page (one menu across the small chain's locations) is a JS-shell in raw HTML with no inline text, but each category is a dated (Feb 2024) banner image (Burrito/Mulita/Nachos/Papa Asada/Tacos/Torta/Fries/Quesa Tacos/Drinks) hosted on the same domain with legible built-in prices, one price per category regardless of protein choice. Menu images are ~2.5 years old at time of capture (site has no newer menu page found); no fresher source located, hence medium rather than high confidence.

name: Kinme Omakase
notes: Omakase-only restaurant (Wed-Sun, two seatings): food is a single seasonal prix fixe ($215/person, +$95 for sake/wine pairing) with no a la carte food items to itemize. Own site's Menu page links to a dated (Jan 2025) 'KINME-DRINK-MENU-Jan-25.pdf' bar menu (tea, soda, beer, sake, wine) with full itemized prices, extracted here directly from the PDF. Sake and multi-pour wines list glass/carafe/bottle or glass/bottle prices; the lowest (by-the-glass or smallest-pour) price is recorded as canonical with all tiers noted in the description. No vegetarian/vegan food options offered per the site.

name: Ferlini Coffee
blocked: Own domain (ferlinicoffee.com, http and https, bare and www) times out on connect - unreachable from this environment. Confirmed via Serper as a real, currently open coffee/wine bar at 613 Pearl St, La Jolla (opened ~spring 2026 per San Diego Union-Tribune business roundup, active Sept 2026 Yelp reviews). joe.coffee listing explicitly states it has no online ordering platform (Square/Toast/Clover/Lightspeed/Revel/TouchBistro/SpotOn all listed as not connected) and is an about/hours page only, no menu or prices. lajolla.ca explore page returned HTTP 202 (JS shell, no content on static fetch). Instagram/TikTok/news posts describe menu items (tiramisu latte, Turkish coffee, smoothies, pastries, cannoli) in prose but publish no prices.
